budgets.accounting: N = ceil(cells * percent / 100) ranked cells (score desc, cell ordinal asc) UNION seed cells; retained = |R| / cells; post-validator K/U reported separately (structural closure)

adaptive.abstention: if b > MAX_RETENTION (0.60): broad AOT for that image (retained = 1.0, recall complete by construction)
adaptive.budget: b = ceil_to_0.01(e + m); N = ceil(cells * b) ranked cells UNION seed cells; retained = |R| / cells
adaptive.density_estimate: e = |{cells: probability >= 0.5}| / cells (the model's own code-density estimate at its balanced decision boundary)
adaptive.fitting_images: development: the out-of-fold records of the OTHER development lineages (nested by lineage; no inner refits - their fold models included the held-out lineage in training, a disclosed limitation); sealed: all development OOF records
adaptive.inputs: cell probabilities of the candidate (label-free), seed cells, decision-cell count; nothing else
adaptive.margin_fit: m = max over FITTING images i of (residual_frf_i - e_i) + 0.05, floored at 0; residual_frf_i = smallest fraction of the image's cells, taken in rank order (seeds excluded from the count), that together with the seed cells holds every labelled start

budgets.seeds: Genesis: production direct-control-discovery seed cells; Sonic CD modules: ADR 0140 seed definition

M1_HGB.what: gen2 M1: HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=200, max_depth=4, learning_rate=0.08, min_samples_leaf=40, l2_regularization=1.0, max_bins=255, early_stopping=False, class_weight=balanced, random_state=49) over the 219 gen2 multiscale aggregates; masked cells excluded

M3_FROZEN.predictions: historical title-held-out outer folds for s1/flicky/sf1/ps2/sk (reproduced, digest-verified); the production model (trained on those five) for every other image (zero-shot for D05-D12; lineage-correlated for s2/scd (D01) and sf2 (D03), flagged)
M3_FROZEN.what: production gen2 M3 weights + representation + token contract, unchanged

M3_R.what: gen2 M3 architecture, representation and recipe unchanged (seed 49, 30 epochs, AdamW, cosine), trained on the training lineages' images; masked cells carry zero loss weight; pos_weight over labelled cells

M4_DENSE.training: margin 512 words of real context or PAD on each side, central 2048 words, batch 8, 4000 steps, AdamW lr 0.002 (x0.1 after 80%), weight decay 1e-4, masked BCE with pos_weight = mean over training lineages of negative/positive labelled words; sampling uniform over training lineages, then images by size within the lineage, window starts multiple of 16 words including image edges; seeds 1, 2, 3; ensemble = mean of the three word logits; no hard-positive emphasis
M4_DENSE.what: dense per-word occupancy CNN: per-word input = embed(hi byte,8) + embed(lo byte,8) + the gen2 MC68000 decode-token embeddings (CPU-owned tokens, same dims as M3) with a distinct PAD index for every channel outside the image; local path 2x Conv1d k5 (32 ch) at word resolution; context path Conv1d k4 stride 4 (32 ch) + residual dilated Conv1d k5 dilations 1,2,4,8,16,32 (radius 504 words = 1008 bytes); fuse 1x1 (64->32) + ReLU + 1x1 head -> per-word logit; cell score = max word logit over the cell; cells {128, 64} bytes evaluated as aggregation only (the same networks)

classification: 1 RECALL_FAILED: no complete development pair, or the frozen pair misses >= 1 confidently labelled start on any qualified sealed lineage
2 CORPUS_INSUFFICIENT: fewer than 12 qualified development or 7 qualified sealed lineages (qualified-entry results reported separately; no promotion)
3 ECONOMICS_NOT_JUSTIFIED: the incumbent M3_FROZEN+B35 is retained, or the frozen alternative fails an economics gate
6 V3_READY_FOR_OPT_IN: frozen pair uses M4_DENSE or M1_HGB
positive outcomes (4-6) additionally require the independent adversarial review's concurrence; otherwise the conservative class stands

environment_rule: Python/numpy/scikit-learn/torch versions, device, precision (float32), threads and deterministic-algorithm settings are recorded in the frozen record before the sealed truth is opened
final_fit: the frozen configuration refit once on ALL qualified development lineages (same recipe/seeds); M3_FROZEN uses the production weights unchanged; an adaptive policy's margin is fitted on all development OOF records of that configuration

hardware.benchmark: before M4-Dense training: verify the available ROCm/PyTorch device without driver changes; final M4-Dense architecture and batch; representative qualified development data; warm-up then one representative epoch (= 500 steps) on CPU (2 threads) and ROCm, repeated 3x; epoch time, data-loading share, throughput, peak RSS/VRAM; estimated total cross-validation time for the actual parallel-CPU farm (8 concurrent 2-thread fits) versus ROCm; ROCm same-seed repeat reproducibility of the trained outputs
hardware.rule: ROCm only if >= 25% estimated end-to-end improvement over the parallel CPU farm AND reproducible; else parallel CPU; unavailable/unstable ROCm falls back explicitly; no kernel optimisation, no architecture change for GPU speed; one backend for every like-for-like comparison

independence.development_app_code: pairwise containment of 12-byte shingles of labelled app-code instruction runs (I/c bytes); >= 0.30 in either direction = substantially shared application code -> the two projects count as ONE lineage (merged fold), reported
independence.sealed_vs_development: raw-byte 12-byte shingle containment over whole images excluding uniform fill runs (no sealed labels used); >= 0.30 = closely related binary -> reported as correlated (no replacement)
independence.sonic_family: all Sonic-family development titles share fold D01 (similar routines never cross a train/test boundary)

labels.cell: positive iff it holds >= 1 I; negative iff every byte is D; otherwise masked (excluded from loss and from FRF positives/negatives)

classes.D: known data (data rows, project resources, padding explained by the build)
classes.I: MC68000 instruction-start byte of a source-backed instruction row
classes.U: unknown/masked: shared SDK/runtime/libgcc/startup code and data, vectors/header of SDK startup, unverifiable or ambiguous bytes
classes.c: continuation byte of that instruction (decoder length)

labels.dense_word: M4-Dense word label: 1 if the word holds an I or c byte, 0 if both bytes are D, masked otherwise
labels.disassembly: tools/segarecomp_source_map_extract.py listing semantics (ADR 0099 adapters; fails closed); non-instruction explained bytes = D
labels.historical_titles: s1/flicky/sf1/ps2/sk: every byte is explained by the listing, so their cell labels equal the frozen gen2 labels
labels.ida_derived: E05: FIXME/inline-hex rows and non-instruction bytes = U (only instruction rows are confident labels)
labels.recall_scope: only I starts are scored for recall (confidently labelled starts); U never counts as a miss or a negative
labels.sgdk: LTO link-time assembly kept with -save-temps and re-assembled with listings; sections placed with the linker map; app functions/objects = I/c/D; SGDK (libmd, sega.s, rom_head), libgcc and functions whose origin is ambiguous after LTO = U; app resources (rescomp) = D; instrumented build must be byte-identical to the plain build and two clean builds byte-identical

aggregates.complete: C outside R = 0 on every image of every development lineage
aggregates.mean_retained: mean over lineages of the mean retained fraction over the lineage's images
aggregates.worst_lineage_frf: max over lineages of the max FRF over the lineage's images

sealed.binding: before any training: source commit, build inputs, image digest and an opaque truth digest per qualified entry in the sealed manifest; truth artifacts only under PRIVATE_ROOT/sealed; development tooling refuses that directory and every sealed id
sealed.gate: zero-miss: any confidently labelled start of a qualified sealed lineage outside R = failure; no refit, recalibration or widening

sealed.runtime: runnable Genesis images: broad vs frozen pair, identical inputs, explicit instruction budget and wall timeout; runtime-equivalent short traces are never evidence of static recall
sealed.unseal: segarecomp_ml_v3_eval.py sealed: requires segarecomp_ml_v3.frozen.json committed in an ancestor of HEAD and byte-identical, verifies every sealed truth digest, writes a one-shot marker; a second run refuses

selection.frozen_before_sealed: exactly one configuration and one policy, plus the training backend/environment, are recorded in segarecomp_ml_v3.frozen.json and committed before the sealed truth is opened
selection.incumbent: M3_FROZEN+B35 is retained unless the best alternative pair is complete AND (M3_FROZEN+B35 is incomplete OR the alternative lowers mean retained by >= 0.05 absolute without raising worst-lineage FRF by more than 0.02)
selection.m4_internal: M4_DENSE@128 and @64 are configurations of one candidate; both obey the same rule (disclosed: two aggregations of one network)
selection.no_complete_pair: if no pair is complete, freeze the pair with the fewest development misses (then lowest mean retained) for descriptive sealed evidence; the outcome is RECALL_FAILED
order: 2 lowest worst-lineage FRF of the configuration (tie set within 0.02)
3 lowest mean retained fraction (tie set within 0.02)
4 lowest mean K/U over Genesis development images (tie set within 0.02)
5 simplest configuration (COMPLEXITY_ORDER), then fixed before adaptive, then the smaller fixed budget
selection.pairs: every candidate configuration in COMPLEXITY_ORDER x every policy in {B35, B45, B50, B60, ADAPT}
